About RdyDeck

RdyDeck is a free Pokémon TCG deck grader and prize trainer. Paste a list from Pokémon TCG Live or Limitless to see how well the cards work together, what to fix first, your opening odds and which cards rotate out of Standard next.

Then practice the deck: name your six prize cards, draw opening hands, run drills and keep notes on your matchups. Decks stay in your browser, it works offline and there is no account to make.

Questions about RdyDeck

What is RdyDeck?

RdyDeck is a free web app for Pokémon Trading Card Game players. It grades a 60 card deck, shows its opening odds and which cards rotate out of Standard, and trains you to work out your prize cards.

How does prize card training work?

RdyDeck sets some cards from your deck aside as prizes, 6 by default or 4 or 8, and you flip through the rest. Then you name the cards that are missing. You can add a time limit, and after a few games RdyDeck shows which cards you miss most.

How does the deck grade work?

The grade is out of 10. Synergy checks that the cards support each other: attackers can pay for their attacks, evolutions have what they evolve from, and the deck can draw and search. Power checks that the plan can win: how hard it hits, how many prizes it gives up and how fast it sets up. The grade is Synergy times Power, divided by 10, so the weaker one pulls the grade down. One part of Synergy, how tightly the list fits together, lowers the grade only when the fit is loose, so a focused list can grade a little above Synergy times Power. Each grade shows its own math and comes with a short list of what to fix first.

How does the rotation check work?

RdyDeck reads each card's regulation mark and shows which cards are not Standard legal now, which may rotate next, and which are safe. A card counts as safe only when its mark is confirmed, and a deck with cards that are not legal now grades 4.9 at most.

Which deck lists can I import?

Paste an export from Pokémon TCG Live or a list from Limitless TCG, one card per line with the count, name, set code and number. Starter decks are built in if you want to try it first.

Is RdyDeck free? Do I need an account?

RdyDeck is free and has no account. Your decks stay in your browser on your own device, it works offline once it has loaded, and you can install it to your home screen.

Unofficial fan-made app. Not affiliated with Nintendo, Creatures, GAME FREAK or The Pokémon Company.

How to play
1
Import your deckPaste your Limitless TCG 60 card list and the app builds your card gallery automatically.
2
Flip through the visible cardsSwipe left and right. Some cards are secretly set aside as prizes before you start.
3
Guess every prize cardType your guesses with autocomplete, then tap Reveal prizes.
4
Challenge modesTap Modes on a deck to change the prize count (4, 6 or 8), add a time limit, or both.
5
Track weak spotsAfter 3 sessions the app shows which cards you miss most often, so you know what to focus on.
6
Practice openings and share listsOpen a deck and use the Hand tab to drill turn 1 lines. The link button at the top gives you a link that opens the list in RdyDeck.
7
Goldfish, drills and notesEach has its own tab on a deck. Hand can goldfish your first three turns. Drills has resource counts and an opponent prize read. Notes keeps matchup plans, an edit log of every card change, and a compare view. Card art you have seen is saved for offline play.

How your friend opens it
  1. Receive the file (iMessage, email, AirDrop and so on)

  3. Tap the Share icon (box with an arrow)
  4. Choose Open in Safari
Don't open it from Discord, Gmail or the Files preview. It has to be Safari.
